domain: Arbitrary n:Nat and arbitrary CommRing R; no positivity, injectivity, domain, or characteristic assumption

obligations.name: ReverseVandermonde.reverse_matrix_as_projective
obligations.statement: of(fun i j:Fin n => (v i)^(n-1-j.val)) = Matrix.projVandermonde (const 1) v

obligations.name: ReverseVandermonde.reverse_vandermonde
obligations.statement: det(of(fun i j:Fin n => (v i)^(n-1-j.val))) = product_i:Fin n product_l in Ioi i (v i-v l)

obligations.name: ReverseVandermonde.power_entries
obligations.statement: For t:Polynomial R and i j:Fin n, (t^(n^i.val))^(n-1-j.val)=t^((n^i.val)*(n-1-j.val))

obligations.name: ReverseVandermonde.reverse_vandermonde_polynomial
obligations.statement: For arbitrary t:Polynomial R, det(of(fun i j:Fin n => t^((n^i.val)*(n-1-j.val)))) = product_i product_l in Ioi i (t^(n^i.val)-t^(n^l.val))

obligations.name: ReverseVandermonde.complementary_exponent
obligations.statement: For all n i j:Nat, (n-1)*n^i-j*n^i = n^i*(n-1-j)

obligations.name: ReverseVandermonde.paper_complementary_det
obligations.statement: For arbitrary t:Polynomial R, det(of(fun i j:Fin n => t^((n-1)*n^i.val-j.val*n^i.val))) = product_i product_l in Ioi i (t^(n^i.val)-t^(n^l.val))

scope: Exact reverse Vandermonde and original complementary determinant entries; no scalar extraction complexity claim
